notes:
Deploy one NEW DisperseV2 from src/DisperseV2.sol on Robinhood Chain (4663), with constructorArgs []. No owner/admin, fee, pause, upgrade, storage or payable entry point. Only the caller's ERC-20 is transferred directly to recipients. Do not redeploy Disperse v1 at 0x49959c0326c4dF604a4d62D46CCBAe3C056CC158. No launch token, pool, distributor, website, funding or initialization.

Reviewed the accepted DisperseV2 source, interfaces, vendored SafeERC20 5.5.0 and relevant tests without changing production code, dependencies, configuration or existing tests. No medium, high or critical finding was demonstrated. This bounded contributor review is not an independent audit.

Validation: forge build and forge test passed: 102 tests, 0 failed, 0 skipped (79 original unit/fuzz, all 11 original fork tests, 12 temporary scratch checks). Fuzz seed: 0xd1ed3dc60b8f8f7574359314867c39a390a7bb1233118bbca64524135764a262; 256 runs per fuzz test. Gas assertions unchanged. Solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200, cancun, via_ir false, bytecode_hash none produced runtime 3838 bytes, keccak256 0x325962a1abe12d0b1de330d0e53257d11a059b9a6beaa0cb9ea38d6f5d13d9a3. Local factory construction and the protected runtime/opcode scan logic passed; no reachable DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE, SELFDESTRUCT or storage writes.

_pull review: CALL writes only 0x00-0x1f; success requires code with empty data or >=32 bytes with first word exactly 1. Short returns are always rejected, including a reproduced case OZ accepts through stale scratch bytes. EXTCODESIZE does not replace returndata. Failure copying is capped at 256 and the free pointer is rounded to 32 bytes; boundary/fuzz checks matched exact TransferFailed encoding. Checked sum overflow, recipient rules, memo bounds/aliases/malformed offsets, Permit decoding and atomic rollback; permit/transfer callbacks into all three entry points could not spend another approver's tokens.

All four imported informational observations reproduced; no fix required: e0627721 (line 114), dirty v=0x1ff succeeds only when unused at deadline=0; deadline=1 reverts, with no redirected payments. a4a1f65e (line 92), legacy deadline=0 calls an expired permit and uses standing allowance; the memo path skips permit, confirmed by exact call count. 8fce4f8a (line 232), runtime MCOPY occurs at 0xed2; RPC https://robinhood-rpc.publicnode.com at block 112770778, 2026-11-12T19:24:09Z, returned chainId 4663 and ArbOS 116, and a read-only MCOPY eth_call returned the expected word 42. 8048e6cf (line 164), a silent token fallback leaves allowance as the gate: InsufficientAllowance(300,0) before approval, exact 100/200 payments after approval. Fork tests also exercised USDG permits/freezing and WEIR/IMD exact payouts.

Accepted limits: fee-on-transfer/rebasing tokens unsupported; event notes are unauthenticated caller data; a failed row does not establish fault; permit revert copying is uncapped. Normal calls do not take custody, but unsolicited token transfers and forced ETH remain unrecoverable because there is no rescue. Scratch reproductions are excluded from submission. No Slither/Mythril or formal verification was run. The service's full protected harness, attestation, admission, simulation, broadcast and explorer verification remain deployment steps. Neither owner deployment script was run; no transaction was broadcast, and no deployment address or result was fabricated.
